summary.text: Caroline McCree is the Democratic candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 75 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Jed Davis (R).
McCree works in health care and lives in Kendall County.

paragraphs.text: McCree graduated from Oswego High School and earned an associate degree from Waubonsee Community College in 2020.
Her career experience includes working in health care.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a single mother from Kendall County who has used public aid and has had difficulty finding employment and affordable housing.
McCree won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary.

She said in the survey that she decided to run after seeing how changes at the state level could help local governments assist residents, such as with homelessness prevention, basic health care and mental health services.
